## `/fundadmin:fund performance-calc <data>` {#performance-calc}

Performance metrics (IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI)

Computes IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, MOIC, and PME from cash flows or a capital account statement, with helper bisection workpapers and J-curve analysis. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund performance-calc`, asks what a fund returned, or shares cash flow data.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund performance-calc <data>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-performance-calc <data>` |
| Codex | `$fund-performance-calc <data>` |

**Writes** `PERFORMANCE-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-performance-calc/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund cashflow-forecast <data>` {#cashflow-forecast}

Cash flow forecasting & liquidity planning

Projects capital calls, distributions, and NAV from explicit dated assumptions using deterministic Decimal workpapers, with scenario comparisons. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund cashflow-forecast` or asks to forecast calls or LP liquidity.

## `/fundadmin:fund scenario-model <data>` {#scenario-model}

Scenario modeling & sensitivity analysis

Models fund outcomes under Downside, Base Case and Upside assumptions: IRR, TVPI, DPI, carried interest, LP net returns and waterfall tier reached, plus sensitivity and breakeven. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund scenario-model` or asks to stress-test returns.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|

**Writes** `SCENARIO-MODEL-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-scenario-model/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund fee-audit <file>` {#fee-audit}

Fee recomputation against supplied LPA terms

Recomputes management fee, offset, preferred return, catch-up, carry and clawback arithmetic and compares it with the supplied LPA terms, flagging differences and unsupported models. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund fee-audit`, asks if fees are correct, or shares fee workpapers.
